title: Open subgroups and finite etale covers
statement: Let $Y$ be a connected scheme [def-weil-connected-scheme] with a geometric point $\bar y$, and put $G=\pi_1(Y,\bar y)$ [def-galois-fibre-functor]. Finite etale covers and their geometric fibres are as in [def-galois-categories]. The assignment sending a nonempty connected finite etale cover $P\to Y$ to the conjugacy class of $\operatorname{Stab}_G(p)$, for any $p\in |P_{\bar y}|$, is a well-defined bijection between isomorphism classes of such covers and conjugacy classes of open subgroups of $G$. More precisely, isomorphism classes of pointed nonempty connected finite etale covers $(P,p)$ of $Y$, with $p\in |P_{\bar y}|$ and isomorphisms required to carry the marked geometric-fibre point to the marked point, correspond bijectively to individual open subgroups by $(P,p)\mapsto\operatorname{Stab}_G(p)$. In both forms the degree of $P\to Y$ (its constant finite locally free rank [def-pc-finite-locally-free]) equals $[G:\operatorname{Stab}_G(p)]$.

proof.text: Use the existing finite étale Galois-category instances and the upstream FundamentalGroup.OpenSubgroups API. The upstream formulation allows a separably closed geometric point and any fundamental-group model G : Type u. Such a model exists by exists_isFundamentalGroup and is canonically topologically isomorphic to Aut(fiber s) by toAutContinuousMulEquiv, compatibly with evaluation. Hence it describes the same subgroups and fibres. ConnectedSpace P.obj.left and IsConnected P are equivalent by FundamentalGroup.Connected; connected fibres are transitive.

The proved upstream isOpen_stabilizer gives open fibre stabilizers. exists_isConnected_stabilizer_eq realizes an open subgroup by the finite continuous coset action G/H, using exists_fiber_equiv and the finite étale equivalenceContAction. Nonempty transitive fibre implies IsConnected by isConnected_of_isPretransitive; connectedSpace_of_isConnected gives scheme connectedness.

The proved upstream exists_equiv_of_stabilizer_eq constructs the pointed equivariant bijection by orbit-stabilizer. Full faithfulness of equivalenceContAction lifts it to an isomorphism of covers, yielding exists_iso_fiber_map_eq_iff. Conversely naturality and injectivity preserve stabilizers. The proved nonempty_iso_iff expresses the unpointed criterion as equality with the stabilizer of g • q. The action identity h fixes g • q iff g⁻¹hg fixes q is exactly the stated conjugacy relation.

The proved upstream natCard_fiber_eq_index identifies the fibre cardinality of a connected cover with the stabilizer index. The new, fully proved lem-fet-geometric-fiber-degree directly identifies this index with the finite locally free degree of the cover morphism, by a geometric-fibre computation and the same Mathlib orbit-stabilizer theorem. Thus the rank conclusion is preserved, not replaced merely by a set-cardinality convention. The lisse-trivialization consumer imports both the official classification and this degree comparison.

lean.statement: theorem galois_openSubgroups : (∀ (P : Y.FiniteEtale) (x : (fiber s).obj P), IsOpen (MulAction.stabilizer G x : Set G)) ∧ (∀ H : OpenSubgroup G, ∃ (P : Y.FiniteEtale) (x : (fiber s).obj P), IsConnected P ∧ MulAction.stabilizer G x = H) ∧ (∀ (P Q : Y.FiniteEtale) [IsConnected P] [IsConnected Q] (x : (fiber s).obj P) (y : (fiber s).obj Q), Nonempty (P ≅ Q) ↔ ∃ g : G, MulAction.stabilizer G x = MulAction.stabilizer G (g • y)) ∧ ∀ (P : Y.FiniteEtale) [IsConnected P] (x : (fiber s).obj P), Nat.card ((fiber s).obj P) = (MulAction.stabilizer G x).index

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $Y$ be connected with geometric point $\bar y$. Assigning to a
connected finite etale cover $P$ the stabilizer in $\pi_1(Y,\bar y)$ of a
point of $P_{\bar y}$ is a bijection between the isomorphism classes of
connected finite etale covers of $Y$ and the open subgroups of
$\pi_1(Y,\bar y)$, and the degree of $P$ over $Y$ is the index of the
subgroup.

proof.text:
Here $\pi_1=\pi_1(Y,\bar y)=\operatorname{Aut}(F_{\bar y})$ is the group
of [def-galois-fibre-functor] and the covers are the finite etale
covers of [def-galois-object]. Under [thm-galois-fundamental] connected finite etale covers of $Y$
correspond to transitive finite continuous $\pi_1$-sets — the
transitivity being that of [lem-galois-transitive] — i.e. to
$\pi_1/H$ with $H$ open: the stabilizer of a point of $P_{\bar y}$ is
that subgroup, and $\#F_{\bar y}(P)=\#\pi_1/H=[\pi_1:H]$ is the degree. A
morphism of connected covers corresponds to an equivariant map
$\pi_1/H\to\pi_1/H'$, which exists exactly when $H'$ is contained in
$H$ up to conjugacy, so the assignment is bijective on isomorphism
classes.
